about: In the year 22XX, fragments from a meteorite that crash-landed on Earth lead to the discovery of a mysterious new mineral known as Force Metal. Advancements made possible through the application of Force Metal revolutionize Reploid engineering, and a massive artificial island known as Giga City is constructed to mine its valuable ore. At first, operations on the island appear to be running smoothly... But one day, a group of Reploids on the island arm themselves, declare themselves the Rebellion, and rise up against the authorities. The government identifies their leader, Epsilon, as a Maverick and dispatches an elite team of Maverick Hunters to Giga City. And so, on the colossal artificial island of Giga City, X’s fierce battle begins.
summary: Turn action into command in this fan-favorite title from the Mega Man X series.
